content.text:
The video shows a robot arm, filmed from behind its right shoulder. The image's left is the robot's left (+y); the far side of the table is the robot's front (+x).

## Objects detected in the first frame (use exactly these names)
- red_bin: a red open-top square bin (16 cm wide, low walls) (color red, kind bin)
- blue_bin: a blue open-top square bin (16 cm wide, low walls) (color blue, kind bin)
- red_block: a small red cube (4 cm) (color red, kind block)
- blue_block: a small blue cube (4 cm) (color blue, kind block)

## Segmentation tracks from SAM 3.1
Tracked objects (54 frames at 5 fps, image 960x540 px; boxes are [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixels; image left is the robot's left):
- red_bin: start box [681, 151, 899, 404] (frame 0), end box [680, 151, 897, 403] (frame 53); did not move; mask coverage 100%
- blue_bin: start box [96, 167, 307, 431] (frame 6), end box [95, 167, 309, 431] (frame 53); did not move; mask coverage 89%
- red_block: start box [462, 331, 530, 422] (frame 0), end box [507, 399, 525, 434] (frame 15); moved, starting around frame 10; mask coverage 30%
- blue_block: start box [477, 203, 533, 280] (frame 0), end box [477, 204, 533, 281] (frame 36); did not move; mask coverage 69%

## How to write the plan
- objects: every object listed above, with its color and kind.
- steps: one pick_and_place per object the robot moves, in the order shown. index starts at 0.
- destination: the object it was put in or on, or "free_table_space" when it was set on the bare table. Never coordinates.
- note (at most 120 characters): when the choice of which object to move depends on a spatial relationship to another object rather than the object's color or name, add a note to that step describing the rule. Otherwise omit the note.
- goal: the relations that hold at the end and capture what the demonstration was for. Allowed relations: in, on, left_of, right_of, next_to, swapped_with.

## Relation definitions
  in            subject's center is inside the target bin's inner footprint and below its rim
  on            subject rests on top of target: centers within 2 cm horizontally and the
                subject's bottom within 1.5 cm of the target's top
  left_of       subject is at least 3 cm further left (+y) than target, and the two are
                within 15 cm of each other front-to-back (x)
  right_of      the mirror of left_of (at least 3 cm further -y)
  next_to       centers within 9 cm horizontally, and neither is on top of the other
  swapped_with  subject ends within 3 cm (horizontally) of where target started, and
                target ends within 3 cm of where subject started

request.instructions: You watch a demonstration of a robot arm moving objects on a table and write down the plan it demonstrates, as JSON matching the given schema.
